scope: Bounded rapid review for a reproducible, inspectable split-assignment export in an existing retrospective aqueous-solubility benchmark. Recent window 2022-01-01 through 2026-10-20; foundational data/benchmark studies retained when directly required.
inclusion_criteria: Primary studies addressing solubility dataset curation/evaluation and foundational papers for the included benchmark
Official versioned software documentation needed to interpret grouped cross-validation or preprocessing leakage
A concrete consequence for documenting, checking, or exporting existing partitions
exclusion_criteria: Formulation, synthesis, clinical delivery, and protein-solubility experiments outside small-molecule benchmark evaluation
Architecture comparisons that do not change this bounded audit implementation
Unverifiable quantitative claims, review-level performance estimates, or new datasets requiring changed endpoint/licensing assumptions

limitations: Non-exhaustive first-page screening; unreturned pages of PM1-PM3 were not screened

Author/MeSH nested metadata lists were capped; full author enumeration was not needed for screening

No effect-size synthesis or meta-analysis; no claim that all relevant literature was found
No external repository code copied or analogous GitHub implementation inspected in this change; official scikit-learn documentation was pinned to version 1.8.0
